pr.title: Fix Azure Functions E2E HTTPS endpoint readiness race
pr.author: ellahathaway

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Job fails with generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' on the 'Run extension E2E tests' step; job logs could not be fetched and no TRX test results were produced. The PR only modifies extension/src/test-e2e/azureFunctions.e2e.test.ts, extension/src/test-e2e/helpers/assertions.ts, and extension/src/test/e2eResourceReadiness.test.ts, none of which are part of the 'browser-debugger' E2E shard, so the failure is unrelated to PR changes and matches the known unrelated-shard-failure flaky pattern.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Same shard failing on both Linux and Windows runners with identical 'Process completed with exit code 1' and no retrievable logs or TRX data. The 'browser-debugger' shard is unrelated to the PR's Azure Functions E2E and assertion helper changes, indicating an intermittent/environmental failure rather than a PR code issue.
